batch100
Snapshot: Candidate 19049abc4a316a699c703f2e3bdf2e2d5eea7724; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base de94fbd9cf2d19413275e6acc7c3e2a020166fd6. Both gates passed; 2200 candidate runtime objects; all four new stroke files raw-identical. The frozen prospective count 2196 is an arithmetic erratum; actual count is 2200, with no semantic effect.
Scope: Every requested guidance/rubric window, primary lesson window, context pair, comparison window, official-evidence window, pool window, author-record window, and navigation window returned completely with exit 0; none unread. Read all four new EN/RU lessons; 22 context EN/RU pairs; 5 EN-only comparisons; 15 whole KANJIDIC2 records plus header and radical evidence; 68 JMdict entries; 4 KanjiPedia entries; all 346 typed quiz rows; 12 proposals, 4 adjudications, 4 clarifications, 4 outside-limit records, and 13 exact navigation diffs. No web pages consulted.
C1 CLEAN: Verified the four lessons against frozen EN and the official captures for readings, strokes, keys, meanings, examples, okurigana and compounds. Mnemonics are labeled as memory aids, not history; no confirmed correctable Japanese-fact defect.
C2 UNVERIFIED: All 13 edits are glyph-only navigation wrappers to the matching new cards; links/targets and unchanged prose/metadata are confirmed. Four lesson adjudications and four bounded dictionary clarifications are supported. Each directed foil works as an introductory/source-core comparison only; ordinary active-negative quiz safety remains unverified, so this is not quiz-guard approval.
C3 CLEAN: No confirmed correctable Russian comprehensibility/naturalness defect in the four lessons or wrappers. No native-speaker or learning-outcome claim.
N001変→夏 S-intro; 変「изменение; странный」vs 夏「лето」; shape comparison only, not a blanket negative.
N002変→文 S-intro; 変 vs 文「предложение; письменный текст」; change/strangeness vs writing; ordinary negative unverified.
N003変→夜 S-intro; 変 vs 夜「ночь」; distinct core senses, shape comparison only.
N004太→犬 S-intro; 太「толстый; полный」vs 犬「собака」; distinguish dot placement; other senses/options not cleared.
N005太→天 S-intro; 太 vs 天「небо」; distinguish size/thickness from sky; 太陽 is a contextual association, not disjointness proof.
N006太→木 S-intro; 太 vs 木「дерево; древесина」; thick tree/timber contexts remain possible; not a blanket negative.
N007夫→失 S-intro; 夫「муж」vs 失「терять; потеря」; official man/husband vs loss/error senses. Direct direction assessed independently; ordinary negative unverified.
N008夫→天 S-intro; 夫 vs 天「небо」; husband/man vs sky/heaven; shape comparison only.
N009夫→大 S-intro; 夫 vs 大「большой」; husband/man vs large/great; size-domain resemblance does not establish a shared answer.
N010失→夫 S-intro; 失「терять; потеря」vs 夫「муж」; loss/failure vs husband/man. Independently assessed, not inferred from N007; loss-of-loved-one context leaves ordinary negative unverified.
N011失→天 S-intro; 失 vs 天「небо」; loss/error vs sky/heaven; shape comparison only.
N012失→牛 S-intro; 失 vs 牛「корова; крупный рогатый скот」; loss/error vs cattle; losing cattle is a context, not a sense equivalence.
L001変 SUPPORTED-intro: readings/strokes and change/strangeness split agree with sources; optional links remain plain where no RU runtime article exists.
L002太 SUPPORTED-intro: readings/strokes and thick/plump vs great in 太陽 are supported; mnemonic is not etymology.
L003夫 SUPPORTED-intro: readings/strokes, husband/man distinction, 夫婦/夫妻 uses supported; absent RU word cards remain unlinked.
L004失 SUPPORTED-intro: readings/strokes, loss/failure and 失敗 pronunciation supported; absent 失礼 card remains unlinked.
A001 SUPPORTED-bounded: 変 senses, transitive/intransitive pair, and 変わった unusual sense are bounded to captured entries; no frequency claim.
A002 SUPPORTED-bounded: 太い/太る and 太陽 greatness sense supported; contrasts are context-specific.
A003 SUPPORTED-bounded: 夫/夫婦/夫妻 claims, including formality note, match JMdict; それ remains metadata-only.
A004 SUPPORTED-bounded: 失う/失敗/失礼 senses match JMdict; う.せる remains metadata-only.

NAV08 words/大変.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 変 → ../kanji/変.md.
NAV09 words/太い.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 太 → ../kanji/太.md.

NAV11 words/太陽.md: NAV-ONLY; wraps 太 → ../kanji/太.md.

Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001 LIMIT—化/変 share inherited «изменение», disambiguated by second gloss; neither creates a distractor edge. O002 LIMIT—大/太 share size domain but titles differ and 大 is not a 太 foil. O003 LIMIT—主/男 have husband/man adjacency but are not 夫 foils; 夫→大 is evaluated separately at N009. O004 LIMIT—死/失 and 礼/失礼 have adjacent senses, not a current foil edge; the reported 天.md vs 夫.md stroke-description difference is outside this batch and unresolved here.
Findings: none.
Optional: None.
Limits: No ordinary active-negative quiz-safety approval for N001–N012; quiz runtime/options and app/device behavior not tested. Review is limited to assigned windows, not all corpus prose. No web consultation, native-speaker validation, or learning-effectiveness evaluation. The existing 天.md comparison noted under O004 was not changed or adjudicated.
